content.comment_body: Hello. I would like to know if there is a watchdog contact available for [product_name]? Specifically, if the device powers off or encounters a fault, would such a contact activate? I am using [product_no] version of [product_name]. Thanks.

No, [product_name] does not include a watchdog function in the manner you described. There is a diagnostic bit for Ethernet monitoring which can be accessed using a specific address as an NI. However, this method only works reliably when directly connecting [product_name] to the partner device. If a network switch or router is present in the connection, monitoring may not function consistently. For greater reliability, it is advisable to create your own watchdog logic.

Here's an example: You can experiment with the timing of on delays and pulse generators to achieve the desired operation. Make sure the on delay periods are set longer than those of the pulse generators.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users noted that [product_name] lacks a native watchdog contact feature. While a diagnostic bit can be used for Ethernet monitoring, it is not dependable if the network involves devices like switches or routers. As a result, users are required to design custom watchdog solutions since the provided options do not adequately support reliable fault detection.
analysis.user_expectations: Users seek an integrated, dependable watchdog contact or diagnostic tool in [product_name] that activates an external signal reliably during faults or power loss.
